_instructions: Author ALL cases and reference targets BEFORE querying the library. Write targets in free text; map to record ids afterward. Commit the file before the first eval run. Cases per presentation: 3-5 base cases, each with one perturbation pair and one noise variant.
input_oneliner: 74M with AS on last echo 2 years ago, syncope while climbing stairs, no prodrome
